title: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)
about: Purdue College of Engineering summer research programme for undergraduates from Purdue, other U.S. and international institutions. International students needing a J-1 visa should apply by 15 December 2026; the priority deadline is 15 January 2027, rolling afterwards.
requirements: Undergraduate students enrolled at Purdue University, other U.S. institutions, and international institutions
